name: Bad Beat
flavor: Nothing you did. The rope was always frayed, the flagstone was always loose, and this was always the moment.
description: You call the odds against one creature you can see within range and let them arrive. It makes a Dexterity saving throw against your {{trick save DC|8 + proficiency bonus + your trick ability modifier}}. On a failure it takes [[2d6]] physical damage as something around it gives way — footing, fitting, its own weapon's grip — and it is knocked prone. On a success it takes half as much damage and stays on its feet. Casting this costs 1 Mirth, spent as you cast; like every costed Turn it generates none back.
narration: You do not touch it and you do not point. You just say something that turns out to be true a half-second later, and the world does the rest.
sheetSummary: Action, 60 ft, cooldown 2, costs 1 Mirth. Dexterity save vs {{trick save DC|8 + proficiency bonus + your trick ability modifier}}. Fail: [[2d6]] physical and knocked prone. Success: half damage, not prone.
